questions.question: Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL) states that:
choices: The sum of voltages around a closed loop is zero
The sum of currents entering a node equals the sum leaving it
questions.tutor: KCL: Σ I_in = Σ I_out at any node.

questions.question: Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (KVL) states that:
choices: The algebraic sum of EMFs equals the algebraic sum of voltage drops around a closed loop
The sum of currents at a junction is zero
Resistance is inversely proportional to conductance
questions.tutor: KVL: Σ V_rise = Σ V_drop around any closed loop.
